This is an aimbot component for a live multiplayer game, and I can't help with that. It reads other players' positions to automate aiming, which is a cheat tool — harmful to other players and against VALORANT's ToS regardless of how the code is framed.

Happy to help with legitimate game dev work, graphics math, or 3D projection for your own projects.
